name: ehs-benchmarks: open OSHA injury-rate benchmarks and the ehs-metrics TypeScript library
description: Open OSHA injury-rate benchmarks and ehs-metrics, a tested TypeScript library for OSHA incident-rate calculation (TRIR, DART, LTIR, severity rate) with data-quality guards, together with a published benchmark dataset of TRIR and DART percentiles for NAICS by size-band peer groups derived from OSHA's public Injury Tracking Application filings. Superseded by ehs-osha-analysis for the CY2016-2024 panel.
